runtime_contract_lineage_repair.description: Exact Unified-Registry -> Hash-Lineage -> runtime-contract repair scope. It permits only the canonical contract registry, its active runtime projection, strict hash/interface guards, the exact formal-signal Artifact materialization edge from the existing Signal Pool into Artifact Transport, the exact formal-signal -> Agent1 handoff inside the existing single worker, Agent3 exact-path semantic repair, completed-contract projection, Agent stage Artifact refs and structured current-state failure projection. The V22 runtime installer is allowed only for the exact authority correction that stops release-version projection from overwriting the immutable operating-evidence contract version; it must not add a new Signal Pool dependency or compatibility bridge. Signal Pool may call the existing Artifact Transport only to materialize the registered immutable signal.signal_ref after evidence-contract validation; it must preserve dataVersion, signalId, sourceSignalId, product/store identity and sourceRef, must not create a second queue/worker, and must fail closed when ART-* validation fails. Runtime membership may change only when the added/removed file is explicitly allowlisted or owned by an explicitly allowed registry module. The competition handoff must preserve formal signalRef and identity, creates no second Worker/Queue and does not relax fail-closed hash checks. All unrelated production files, modules, nodes and special hashes remain fail-closed.
